head: Meta's new Style Sketch app plans outfits from your own clothes
dek: Meta quietly released Style Sketch, an AI app that builds a virtual closet and suggests outfits from clothes you already own. It's out on iPhone and Android in Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand.
details: It can build the closet from photos you posted on Instagram, or you add items by photo, short video or camera roll. It shows outfits on a model matched to your body shape and skin tone, can build looks around one item, and plans day-by-day outfits for trips using the weather forecast. Meta hasn't said whether it will come to more countries.
where: iPhone and Android, Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand
means: If you live in one of the three countries, you can try it now; elsewhere it isn't available yet.
todo: Nothing to do outside those countries. If you try it, check what it may take from your Instagram account before you connect it.
